verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://docs.honeycomb.io/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured index linking to markdown versions of doc pages. Honeycomb also publishes LLM-oriented markdown bundles (/_llms/send-data.md) and an agent-skills plugin that gives AI assistants Honeycomb knowledge. Missing for 10: no independent community or hands-on report of agents actually consuming these docs in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
